name: Visual Studio Code
note: VS Code uses the historical product name `Code`, so the generic Electron lookup cannot reach it. `User`, `workspaceStorage`, `History`, and extensions stay in the protected remainder. The editor's own record decides which extension versions are obsolete, never the version number. A pinned older version makes the highest version the wrong guess. So do profiles that share the folder.
